name: react-harness
description: The core of React Harness for Claude Code: a hook that routes every session to nine convention skills (React 19, TanStack Query, shadcn/ui, forms, routing, TypeScript, error handling, code shape, testing), so a plain request comes out in one structure and style. Optional stages started by you: spec, plan, implement, verify, review, refine, and autopilot for a hook-driven verify → refine → review loop. Pair with feature-folders or feature-sliced-design; add a design plugin for the look.
